voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: On the night of the eighth of February, eighteen fifty-five, after heavy snow, something left tracks across Devon, in England.
By morning, people found small, hoof-shaped prints in the snow, mostly in a single line.
They were reported from more than thirty places. Witnesses said the tracks went over rooftops, and walls, as if nothing were there.
Theories followed. An escaped kangaroo. Hopping mice. A balloon, dragging chains.
None of them has ever been proved.
